about: ROUNDS controls on the blob. Player 1 gets ROUNDS's keyboard and mouse layout in levels (read directly, so Cuphead's saved bindings are never changed); Cuphead's own bindings and gamepads keep working. CupheadButton ids from Cuphead's CupheadButton enum.

columns.cupheadButton: Rewired action id read from the player's Cuphead input (-1 = none)
columns.keyboardExtra: ROUNDS-style extra for the keyboard player (player 1 only)

rows.keyboardExtra: A / D (Cuphead's move keys also work)
rows.notes: Cuphead's motor walks; speed comes from the build

rows.keyboardExtra: W / Space (Cuphead's jump key also works)
rows.notes: in the air: extra jump if the build has one, against a wall: wall jump

rows.keyboardExtra: mouse, with a ROUNDS-style crosshair; always on for player 1 unless the right stick is in use
rows.notes: free 360 aim; with no mouse or stick input it falls back to the 8-way direction held
auto fire while held unless a card makes it semi-auto
Cuphead's Dash button blocks (the blob has no dash); EX button also blocks
EX/Super button also blocks, since the blob has no EX or super
Cuphead lock: stand still and aim with the move keys

rows.keyboardExtra: left mouse on a card / Enter

rows.notes: buy a card pack at Porkrind's
drawn in the level because Cuphead hides the cursor
